name: Cancer
description: Population mortality for your age and sex combined with U.S. SEER cancer survival for your cancer site, stage and age at diagnosis, allowing for the time you have already survived since diagnosis.

layers.label: Cancer site and stage (SEER)
layers.description: Relative survival for your cancer site, stage and age at diagnosis, diagnosed in the U.S. 2000-2022 and rescaled to 2016-2022 5-year survival. A recorded distant metastasis counts as distant stage, timed from the metastasis. SEER publishes survival up to 10 years after diagnosis; beyond that the 10th year's excess mortality is assumed to continue.
